Class Vehicle

java.lang.Object
Vehicle
All Implemented Interfaces:
Comparable<Vehicle>, VehicleInterface
Direct Known Subclasses:
ElectricVehicle
public class Vehicle extends Object implements VehicleInterface, Comparable<Vehicle>
Represents a standard road vehicle in the car dealership system. Implements VehicleInterface for business pricing and mileage calculations, and Comparable for sorting and ordering in inventory structures.

    • getFinalPrice

      public int getFinalPrice()
      Computes the final selling price considering depreciation, price floor, and fuel type. Formula: - Subtracts 150,000 per year of age from base price. - Ensures a minimum price floor of 200,000. - Multiplies by 1.15 for HYBRID, 1.05 for DIESEL, unchanged for PETROL.
      Specified by:
      getFinalPrice in interface VehicleInterface
      Returns:
      The final selling price rounded to nearest integer

    • compareTo

      public int compareTo(Vehicle other)
      Compares this vehicle with another vehicle for ordering. Primary order: ascending by final price. Secondary tie-breakers: brand, model, mileage, and age to maintain distinct elements in collections.
      Specified by:
      compareTo in interface Comparable<Vehicle>
      Parameters:
      other - The vehicle to compare with
      Returns:
      A negative integer, zero, or a positive integer as this vehicle is less than, equal to, or greater than other
